name: wechat-article-pipeline
description: End-to-end WeChat Official Account article pipeline from topic plan to research, writing, visuals, polishing, and draft-box publishing.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a confirmed topic into a researched, illustrated, polished WeChat article draft.
interface.longDescription: A reusable Codex plugin for WeChat Official Account article production. After a user confirms the topic plan, Codex runs the full pipeline: source intake, evidence register, article drafting, humanized polish, Baoyu-style visual planning and prompts, image QA, markdown validation, and draft-box publishing.
